item.title: FinOps and AI 1: FinOps, from the cloud to AI
item.description:
FinOps from the cloud, where it began, to AI: what it is, how the FinOps Foundation framework works, what the State of FinOps 2026 found, and what changes with AI.

Outline:

  • 0:19 What FinOps is
  • 1:25 Where FinOps came from
  • 2:21 The FinOps Foundation
  • 3:09 Principles and phases
  • 4:45 Maturity and roles
  • 6:33 Unit economics, showback and chargeback
  • 8:27 Rates and commitments
  • 9:32 One format for billing data
  • 10:21 Categories and scopes
  • 11:21 The State of FinOps 2026
  • 14:00 FinOps for AI

Public sources:

  • FinOps Foundation, What is FinOps? (definition, updated November 2026): https://www.finops.org/introduction/what-is-finops/
  • FinOps Foundation, About (history, Linux Foundation, community): https://www.finops.org/about/
  • FinOps Foundation, FinOps Framework (principles, phases, maturity, personas, domains, technology categories and scopes): https://www.finops.org/framework/
  • FinOps Foundation, Unit Economics capability: https://www.finops.org/framework/capabilities/unit-economics/
  • FinOps Foundation, Invoicing & Chargeback capability: https://www.finops.org/framework/capabilities/invoicing-chargeback/
  • FinOps Foundation, Rate Optimization capability: https://www.finops.org/framework/capabilities/rate-optimization/
  • FOCUS, the FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification: https://focus.finops.org/
  • FinOps Foundation, Introducing FOCUS 1.4 (ratified June 4, 2026): https://www.finops.org/insights/introducing-focus-1-4/
  • FinOps Foundation, State of FinOps 2026 (February 19, 2026): https://data.finops.org/
  • FinOps Foundation, FinOps for AI: https://www.finops.org/framework/technology-categories/ai/
  • Tina Schuchman, Microsoft, Azure blog, The Economics of Agent Optimization: From pilots to measurable returns (August 12, 2026): https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/blog/the-economics-of-agent-optimization-from-pilots-to-measurable-returns/
  • KPMG in Canada, news release on the global study of trust in AI by KPMG and the University of Melbourne (June 23, 2025): https://kpmg.com/ca/en/media/2025/06/canada-lagging-global-peers-in-ai-trust-and-literacy.html
  • David Beauchemin, Tokenomics: Turning AI Cost Anxiety Into a Controllable Lever, LinkedIn (June 16, 2026): https://www.linkedin.com/posts/davidbeauchemin_achieving-success-with-ai-the-official-activity-7472717112202055682-j47N
  • Linux Foundation, June 3, 2026 press release on the intent to launch the Tokenomics Foundation: https://www.linuxfoundation.org/press/linux-foundation-announces-the-intent-to-launch-the-tokenomics-foundation-to-establish-open-standards-for-ai-cost-management

item.title: FinOps and AI 2: The economics of AI in the enterprise
item.description:
The economics of AI in the enterprise: why the bill keeps rising, how tokens are priced, four ways to lower the cost, governance, forecasting and how to prove value. The episode ends with a short action plan.

Outline:

  • 0:23 Why the AI bill keeps rising
  • 2:41 How tokens are priced
  • 4:36 Agents and the cost of an outcome
  • 5:28 Four ways to lower the cost
  • 11:17 Measuring what works
  • 12:08 Governance and the limits people set
  • 15:45 Forecasting and allocation
  • 18:10 Proving value
  • 21:23 Where to start

Public sources:

  • David Beauchemin, Innovate at the Frontier: An Executive Framework for Scaling AI (whitepaper, May 2026): https://dbeauchemin.github.io/docs/Innovate%20at%20the%20Frontier%20-%20Executive%20Framework%20for%20Scaling%20AI%20Final.pdf
  • Tina Schuchman, Microsoft, Azure blog, The Economics of Agent Optimization: From pilots to measurable returns (August 12, 2026): https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/blog/the-economics-of-agent-optimization-from-pilots-to-measurable-returns/
  • Goldman Sachs Research, AI Agents Forecast to Boost Tech Cash Flow as Usage Soars (May 20, 2026): https://www.goldmansachs.com/insights/articles/ai-agents-forecast-to-boost-tech-cash-flow-as-usage-soars
  • McKinsey, The cost of intelligence: How CIOs can manage AI demand at scale (July 20, 2026): https://www.mckinsey.com/capabilities/quantumblack/our-insights/the-cost-of-intelligence-how-cios-can-manage-ai-demand-at-scale
  • McKinsey, The new economics of AI: The rising cost of intelligence (October 4, 2026): https://www.mckinsey.com/featured-insights/themes/the-new-economics-of-ai-the-rising-cost-of-intelligence
  • BCG, The Formula for Agentic AI Value: The Applied AI Index 2026 (September 2026): https://www.bcg.com/publications/2026/the-formula-for-agentic-ai-value
  • McKinsey, The state of AI in 2026: On the road to ROI (August 25, 2026): https://www.mckinsey.com/capabilities/quantumblack/our-insights/the-state-of-ai
  • FinOps Foundation, GenAI FinOps: How Token Pricing Really Works (updated October 2026): https://www.finops.org/wg/genai-finops-how-token-pricing-really-works/
  • Steve Sweetman, Microsoft, Azure blog, The Economics of Agent Optimization: Four ways to lower the cost (August 26, 2026): https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/blog/the-economics-of-agent-optimization-four-ways-to-lower-the-cost/
  • Stanford HAI, AI Index Report 2026 (April 2026): https://hai.stanford.edu/ai-index/2026-ai-index-report
  • Jeff Hollan, Microsoft, Azure blog, The Economics of Agent Optimization: Context engineering for enterprise AI agents (September 2, 2026): https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/blog/the-economics-of-agent-optimization-context-engineering-for-enterprise-ai-agents/
  • Microsoft, Microsoft IQ page: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/ai/microsoft-iq
  • Steve Sweetman, Microsoft, Azure blog, The Economics of Agent Optimization: How AI agent governance controls cost and proves ROI (September 10, 2026): https://azure.microsoft.com/en-us/blog/the-economics-of-agent-optimization-how-ai-agent-governance-controls-cost-and-proves-roi/
  • Tokenomics Foundation, State of Tokenomics, Release Candidate 1.0 (preliminary), September 23, 2026: https://www.tokeneconomics.com/state-of-tokenomics/
  • Gartner, June 25, 2025 press release on agentic AI projects: https://www.gartner.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2025-06-25-gartner-predicts-over-40-percent-of-agentic-ai-projects-will-be-canceled-by-end-of-2027
  • FinOps Foundation, FinOps for AI: https://www.finops.org/framework/technology-categories/ai/
  • FinOps Foundation, The Total Cost of AI (TCA) and per Product TCA (November 2026): https://www.finops.org/wg/total-cost-of-ai-tca/
